justification: Inspected android/src/com/google/zxing/client/android/result/supplement/SupplementalInfoRetriever.java plus TitleRetriever.java, ProductResultInfoRetriever.java, BookResultInfoRetriever.java, URIResultInfoRetriever.java. The package has only one outside caller in the repo, CaptureActivity.java, so it is not a highly stable package. Its internal dependencies are on shared packages/classes such as com.google.zxing.client.result.*, com.google.zxing.client.android.history.HistoryManager, HttpHelper, and LocaleManager, which are also referenced from other areas like ResultHandler.java, URIResultHandler.java, SearchBookContentsActivity.java, and HistoryActivity.java. I found no evidence that this package depends on packages that are less stable than itself.
